'''Blue Leader''' was a fighter pilot in the Rebel Alliance that served as the leader of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] in the early years of the Galactic Civil War. The leader provided scouting for [[Tantive IV/Legends|Tantive IV]] during [[Operation Skyhook]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo System]]. But was suprised not to find any [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] activity. Said pirates had been destroyed by the Empire who then hid in the [[Ghost Tide Nebula]] or another nebula.<ref name="EaW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>

The decision to deem the system all clear lead to an [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|Imperial ambush]] where the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star Plans]] were nearly recaptured, Tantive IV was lost and [[Anchorhead Base]] was destroyed with Captain [[Merrick Simms]] barely escaped to take command of Blue Squadron for the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="RA manual">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]'' manual</ref><ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
